title: [AAPS3.0_beta5] NSClient - No Plot on Main Screen
body: No plot after full sync with NS, no other metrics. Creating new issue since quite a few things have been fixed/changed from the initial issue. Data exists in history

comments.body: NO active profile is the issue

@MilosKozak - I cannot set a profile. Please see #808, and your comment on https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/807#issuecomment-962518009 - I believe you told me I cannot have an active profile. I have tried everything possible to set a local profile. It is not possible.
I think I must be missing something #808 even has a video posted of me trying to set a profile.
we were already talking about it, didn't we? you must use full AAPS or PUMPCONTROL to create effective profile switch
@MilosKozak - so are you saying I cannot have a plot in NSclient, by itself?
I understood NSclient to be a standalone client... to visualise NS data and use care portal. Why do I need Pump control or AAPS to see the plot.
bucause no other tool supports new features at the moment
@MilosKozak there seems to be a categorical misunderstanding here. Are you saying NSclient is no longer functional standalone? (at least, not at this point in the beta?)
If so, why am I spending hours testing it?
